data.name: Q_SKYDE_NCRM_AD_HOC_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE
data.queryText:
SELECT
a.CampaignName,
a.Channel1,
a.START_DATE,
a.END_DATE,
'True' AS HAS_RUN,
'False' AS ACTIVE,
GETUTCDATE()
AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
AT TIME ZONE 'Central European Standard Time' AS RUN_TIME
FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/38d9fb0b-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/38d9fb0b-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/name}}] a
JOIN {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/1586e4a5-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/1586e4a5-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/name}}] b 
ON a.CampaignName = b.CampaignName
WHERE RUN_TIME IS NULL

data.name: Q_SKYDE_AdHoc_Target
data.queryText:
SELECT 
    M.ContactId,
    M.FirstName,
    M.LastName,
    M.Emailaddress,
    M.AccountId, 
    M.AccountStatus, 
    M.TypeOfCustomer, 
    M.CustomerNumber, 
    M.Salutation, 
    M.Country, 
    M.CustomerRegistrationType, 
    M.SiebelCustomerNumber, 
    M.Phone, 
    M.MobilePhone, 
    M.Platform, 
    M.Entitle_RequestCancellationReason, 
    M.ReceptionType,
    M.BookedPackages, 
    M.Entitle_RequestCancellationDate, 
    M.Entitle_CommitmentStartDate,
    M.MasterContactLock, 
    M.EmailOptOut, 
    M.IsMailOffers, 
    M.Entitle_ContractId,
    M.Entitle_ContractStatus,
    M.Entitle_ContractNumber, 
    M.City, 
    M.PostalCode,
    M.Entitle_ContractTerm, 
    M.Entitle_ActivatedDate, 
    M.IsDunning,
    C.CampaignName,
CONCAT(
    M.ContactId, '_', 
    C.CampaignName, '_', 
    FORMAT(GETUTCDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmm')
) AS ActionId

    
FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/96f019f8-d7c9-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/96f019f8-d7c9-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/name}}] M
JOIN {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/78b19a31-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/78b19a31-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/name}}] T ON M.ContactId = T.SalesforceId
JOIN {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/38d9fb0b-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/38d9fb0b-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/name}}] C on T.Description = C.CampaignName
/*LEFT JOIN 	[DE_NCM_AdHoc_Entry] E ON T.SalesforceId = E.ContactId
WHERE E.ContactId is null*/
where C.active = 'True'
and (CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS DATE) >= CAST(START_DATE AS DATE) AND CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS DATE) <= CAST(END_DATE AS DATE))
AND C.HAS_RUN = 'False'

data.name: Q_Check_Active_campaigns
data.queryText:
SELECT
CampaignName,
'True' AS Active
FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/38d9fb0b-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/38d9fb0b-15c3-f011-a5d0-5cba2c7ae718/data/name}}]
WHERE
ACTIVE = 'True'
